name: Infinite Everything (test)
author: Sixth Front
description: For testing, not part of the game: import it from MODS → IMPORT MOD FILE. The HANGAR shows ∞ research points and silver, so every ship, aircraft, gun and modification can be researched and bought straight away (what you unlock stays unlocked after you remove the mod). In battle you, your ship and your aircraft take no damage and never run out: ammo with no reloads, gadgets, grenades, missiles, torpedoes, bombs, flares, Phalanx rounds; fires, flooding and knocked-out modules are fixed at once. Remove it to play normally.
script: // Infinite Everything: a test mod (not part of the game). The HANGAR shows ∞ research points and silver, so
// every ship, aircraft, gun and modification can be researched and bought straight away; in battle you,
// your ship and your aircraft never run out of anything and can't be killed.
const h = api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01] }], { x: 0, y: -500, z: 0 });
// the Career's currency: nothing costs anything while this mod is on
const setCareer = (on) => { const C = career(); if (C && C.setInfinite && C.infinite !== on) C.setInfinite(on); };
// nothing hurts you or what you drive
api.filter('vehicleDamage', (e) => { const P = api.player(); return P && e.vehicle && e.vehicle.driver === P ? false : e; });
for (const w of v.weps) { w.ammo = w.def.ammo ?? Infinity; w.rearm = 0; }
for (const m of v.ciws || []) { m.ammo = 1550; m.reloadT = 0; }
for (const w of v.weps || []) if (w.def && w.def.ammo !== undefined) w.ammo = w.def.ammo;
